text: なんびき　あずけても　ただ　だし　こまめに　つかうと　いいよ！

structure.jp: なんびき　あずけても
こまめに　つかうと　いいよ！
structure.en: it's good to use it often!

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.span: なんびき　あずけても
patterns.explanation: A question word plus a verb ending in ても means 'no matter how many'. なんびき　あずけても = 'however many you deposit'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し after a statement gives it as a reason for what comes next. ただ　だし = 'it's free, so'.

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.explanation: A verb followed by といい is a friendly piece of advice: 'it's good if you do this'. つかうと　いい = 'you should use it'.
